status: response-open original-data exploratory analysis; no causal clam persistence effect
limitations: All plots initially received a live clam; no no-clam or empty-shell randomized control.
L is confirmation, not true survival. Non-detection does not identify mortality; later status not routinely recorded.
Dose assigned by row and burial treatment by side of grid, not independently randomized. Row-holdout is internal predictive test, not spatially independent validation.
Shoots are not individually marked seedlings/genets; clonal growth possible. No true seed-fate estimation.
Early shoot count is a predictive state, not causal effect of clam. Model choices post hoc. No new independent field site.
Published 2024 nominal 20 mm furrows differ from Infantes 24-hour 2 cm burial trial in exposure duration and design; no pooled depth threshold.
